prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
For a **custom spray tan**, **Organic Bronze Bar in SouthPark** looks like a strong pick: reviews praise its natural-looking results and friendly, professional technicians. It’s at **2907 Providence Rd., Suite 102A**, and lists appointments at **(980) 498-0008**. [Salon details and reviews](https://organicbronzebar.com/southpark/)

If you mean **UV tanning beds** rather than a spray tan, **Palm Beach Tan** has several Charlotte locations, so the best choice may depend on your neighborhood. Keep in mind that UV tanning increases skin-cancer and skin-aging risk; a sunless spray tan avoids UV exposure.
